value_render_option.description: How cell values are rendered: FORMATTED_VALUE (default), UNFORMATTED_VALUE, or FORMULA.

tools.name: sheets_get_sheet_values
tools.title: Sheets Get Sheet Values

tools.description:
Fetch spreadsheet metadata: properties plus each sheet/tab's title and sheetId.

spreadsheet_id is the file's Drive ID — there is no Sheets-side lookup
tool, so obtain it via drive_list_files or search_workspace first. Set
include_grid_data=true (optionally limited by A1 'ranges') to include
cell data. Returns the Spreadsheet resource, or {"error": ...} on API
failure.

spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the spreadsheet's URL.

tools.name: sheets_get_spreadsheet
tools.title: Sheets Get Spreadsheet

tools.description:
Overwrite the cells in range_a1 with the given row-major values.

value_input_option USER_ENTERED parses values like typed input
(formulas, dates); RAW stores them verbatim. Returns the update reply
(updatedRows/updatedCells counts), or {"error": ...} on API failure.

spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the spreadsheet's URL.

value_input_option.description: How values are interpreted: USER_ENTERED parses them as if typed into the UI (formulas, numbers, dates); RAW stores them as literal strings.

values.description: Replacement tabular row-major values for the given range.

tools.name: sheets_update_sheet_values
tools.title: Sheets Update Sheet Values

tools.description:
Apply raw Slides API batchUpdate requests (create slides, insert text/shapes, etc.).

presentation_id comes from create_presentation or Drive discovery
(drive_list_files / search_workspace). Returns the batchUpdate replies,
or {"error": ...} on API failure.

presentation_id.description: Google Slides presentation ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the presentation's URL.

requests.description: Raw Slides API batchUpdate request objects, e.g. [{"createSlide": {"insertionIndex": 1}}] or createShape/insertText/deleteObject/updatePageElementTransform requests.

tools.name: slides_batch_update_presentation
tools.title: Slides Batch Update Presentation

tools.description:
Create a new presentation with a single default title slide.

Returns the created Presentation resource (including its
'presentationId' for the other slides tools), or {"error": ...} on API
failure.
tools.name: slides_create_presentation
tools.title: Slides Create Presentation

tools.description:
Fetch a presentation's full structure: slides, layouts, masters, and elements.

presentation_id is the file's Drive ID — there is no Slides-side lookup
tool, so obtain it via drive_list_files or search_workspace first.
Returns the Presentation resource (each slide's 'objectId' feeds
get_slide_page / get_slide_thumbnail), or {"error": ...} on API
failure.

presentation_id.description: Google Slides presentation ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the presentation's URL.

tools.name: slides_get_presentation
tools.title: Slides Get Presentation

tools.description:
Fetch one slide (page) with its elements, by the slide's objectId.

page_object_id comes from get_presentation's slides list. Returns the
Page resource, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

page_object_id.description: Slide object ID, from the objectId of an entry in slides_get_presentation's slides list.

presentation_id.description: Google Slides presentation ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the presentation's URL.

tools.name: slides_get_slide_page
tools.title: Slides Get Slide Page

tools.description:
Generate a thumbnail image of one slide and return its download URL.

page_object_id comes from get_presentation's slides list. Returns the
Thumbnail payload ('contentUrl' plus pixel dimensions; the URL is
short-lived), or {"error": ...} on API failure.

page_object_id.description: Slide object ID, from the objectId of an entry in slides_get_presentation's slides list.

presentation_id.description: Google Slides presentation ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the presentation's URL.

thumbnail_size.description: Requested thumbnail image resolution, from largest to smallest.

tools.name: slides_get_slide_thumbnail
tools.title: Slides Get Slide Thumbnail

tools.description:
Replace every occurrence of contains_text across all slides with replace_text.

presentation_id comes from create_presentation or Drive discovery
(drive_list_files / search_workspace). Returns the batchUpdate reply
(including occurrencesChanged), or {"error": ...} on API failure.

contains_text.description: Exact text to find; every occurrence is replaced.

presentation_id.description: Google Slides presentation ID: the Drive file ID, also the long ID in the presentation's URL.

replace_text.description: Text that replaces each occurrence; an empty string deletes the matches.

tools.name: slides_replace_text_in_presentation
tools.title: Slides Replace Text In Presentation

tools.description:
Mark a task as completed, recording the completion timestamp.

Returns the updated task resource, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

completed_at.description: Completion RFC3339 timestamp to record; defaults to the account's current local time.

task_id.description: Task ID, from tasks_list_tasks, tasks_tasks_digest or tasks_create_task results.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_complete_task
tools.title: Tasks Complete Task

tools.description:
Create a task in a tasklist, optionally nested (parent) or positioned (previous).

parent nests the new task as a subtask; previous places it after a
sibling task; both refer to task IDs in the same tasklist. Returns the
created task resource (including its 'id'), or {"error": ...} on API
failure.

due.description: Task due date/time as YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339; normalized to midnight UTC when only a date is given.

parent.description: Parent task ID to nest this as a subtask under; omit for a top-level task.

previous.description: ID of the sibling task this task should be ordered immediately after; omit to place it first.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_create_task
tools.title: Tasks Create Task

tools.description:
Create a new tasklist with the given title.

Returns the created tasklist resource (including its 'id'), or
{"error": ...} on API failure.
tools.name: tasks_create_tasklist
tools.title: Tasks Create Tasklist

tools.description:
Permanently delete a task after interactive host confirmation.

Returns {"status": "deleted"} on success, {"status": "cancelled"} if
the user declines, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

task_id.description: Task ID, from tasks_list_tasks, tasks_tasks_digest or tasks_create_task results.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_delete_task
tools.title: Tasks Delete Task

tools.description:
Fetch one task by tasklist ID and task ID.

Returns the task envelope (title, notes, due, status, overdue state),
or {"error": ...} on API failure.

task_id.description: Task ID, from tasks_list_tasks, tasks_tasks_digest or tasks_create_task results.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_get_task
tools.title: Tasks Get Task

tools.description:
Fetch one tasklist's metadata (title, updated time) by its ID.

Returns the tasklist envelope, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_get_tasklist
tools.title: Tasks Get Tasklist

tools.description:
List the account's tasklists (each tasklist's 'id' feeds the other tasks tools).

Returns {"tasklists": [...], "next_page_token", "count"}, or
{"error": ...} on API failure.

page_token.description: The next_page_token from the previous response of this same call; omit for the first page.

tools.name: tasks_list_tasklists

count.description: Number of items in this response.

fetched_at.description: RFC3339 time when this response was fetched.

next_page_token.description: Opaque token for the next page, or null.

tools.title: Tasks List Tasklists

tools.description:
List tasks in a tasklist, with optional due/completed/updated time filters.

Timestamp filters accept RFC3339 or bare YYYY-MM-DD dates. Returns
{"tasks": [...], "next_page_token", "count", "account_timezone"} with
each task annotated with overdue/due-state info, or {"error": ...} on
API failure.

completed_max.description: Only return tasks completed on or before this RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD date.

completed_min.description: Only return tasks completed on or after this RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD date.

due_max.description: Only return tasks due on or before this RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD date.

due_min.description: Only return tasks due on or after this RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD date.

page_token.description: The next_page_token from the previous response of this same call; omit for the first page.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

updated_min.description: Only return tasks last updated on or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

tools.name: tasks_list_tasks

count.description: Number of items in this response.

fetched_at.description: RFC3339 time when this response was fetched.

next_page_token.description: Opaque token for the next page, or null.

tools.title: Tasks List Tasks

tools.description:
Reorder a task within its tasklist, or move it to another tasklist.

Use parent/previous (task IDs in the same tasklist) to reposition, OR
destination_tasklist_id to move across tasklists — the Tasks API
rejects combining the two, so cross-list moves land at the destination's
default position (reorder with a second call). Returns the moved task
resource, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

destination_tasklist_id.description: Target tasklist ID to move the task into; omit to reorder within the same tasklist.

parent.description: New parent task ID to nest this task under; omit to leave it at the top level.

previous.description: ID of the sibling task this task should be ordered immediately after; omit to place it first.

task_id.description: Task ID, from tasks_list_tasks, tasks_tasks_digest or tasks_create_task results.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_move_task
tools.title: Tasks Move Task

tools.description:
Group incomplete tasks into overdue, upcoming, and unscheduled work.

Returns the grouped digest plus tasklist/window metadata, or
{"error": ...} on API failure.

days.description: Number of days ahead of now that a due task is grouped into 'upcoming' rather than 'unscheduled'.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_tasks_digest
tools.title: Tasks Digest

tools.description:
Patch fields on an existing task; only the supplied fields change.

At least one mutable field must be provided. Returns the updated task
resource, or {"error": ...} on API failure.

completed.description: Completion RFC3339 timestamp to set; typically paired with status='completed'.

deleted.description: Whether to mark the task as deleted.

due.description: Updated due date/time as YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339; normalized to midnight UTC when only a date is given.

hidden.description: Whether to mark the task as hidden from the default task list view.

status.description: Updated task status: needsAction or completed.

task_id.description: Task ID, from tasks_list_tasks, tasks_tasks_digest or tasks_create_task results.

tasklist_id.description: Task list ID from tasks_list_tasklists; '@default' selects the account's default list.

tools.name: tasks_update_task
tools.title: Tasks Update Task
